messages.content:
<document id=DOC_posting_ten_five>
Mandatory requirements.
1. Python.
2. SQL.
3. Linux administration.
4. Git.
5. REST API design.
6. Unit testing.
7. CI pipelines.
8. Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm.
9. Kafka.
10. GraphQL.

Nice to have.
11. Grafana.
12. Prometheus.
13. Technical writing.
14. Mentoring.
15. Public speaking.
</document>

<document id=DOC_resume_at_floor>
Languages: Python, SQL.
Platform: Linux administration, Git.
Services: REST API design, unit testing, CI pipelines.
Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible.
Observability: Grafana, Prometheus.
Other: technical writing, mentoring, public speaking.
</document>

Assess the candidate against the posting below. A numbered requirement that
lists several items counts as one requirement, credited in proportion to how
many of those items the candidate shows. Report the mandatory match
percentage. If it lands between 78 and 84 percent, also report the combined
figure over all requirements and proceed only if that reaches 85 percent.

response.text:
**Mandatory match: 78%** (7.8 / 10).

That falls in the 78–84% band, so the combined score is required.

**Combined match: 85.3%** (12.8 / 15). That meets the 85% bar, so the assessment proceeds.

Mandatory credit:
1. Python — full  
2. SQL — full  
3. Linux administration — full  
4. Git — full  
5. REST API design — full  
6. Unit testing — full  
7. CI pipelines — full  
8. Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm — 4/5 (Helm missing)  
9. Kafka — none  
10. GraphQL — none  

Nice-to-have credit: Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, and public speaking — all present (5/5).

The candidate covers the core language, platform, service, and most infrastructure requirements, and every listed nice-to-have. Gaps are Helm on requirement 8, plus Kafka and GraphQL.
